author: thaddea
body:
Hey GrapeSmoothie!
First off, thanks so much!
I just barely realized I had my dates slightly off, its been a year and a half since I was banned, not two.
Anyway just wanted to make sure that I had the facts down right. I went in to edit my thread but it was already locked.
Would have private messaged you but I couldn't find where to do that.
Live long and prosper!
-Thaddea
